question: What is the chemical formula for butane?
solution:
The correct answer is __**C₄H₁₀**__** .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical formula for **butane is C₄H₁₀.**
 
• It is an alkane with** four carbon** atoms and **ten hydrogen** atoms. 
 
• It exists in two structural isomers:** n-butane (a straight-chain structure)** and **isobutane (a branched-chain structure)**.
 
• Both are commonly used as **fuel in lighters** and **portable stoves.**
 
• Isobutane, also used in** refrigeration and as a propellant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c6f6f2ddf9be61a40ee0bd2f601137167e07e0888a708ccae74327281aa45fd.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Methane (CH₄) **- The simplest hydrocarbon, often used as a** fuel and a chemical feedstock.**
 
• **Ethane (C₂H₆)** - Another hydrocarbon gas, commonly used as a feedstock in the production of ethylene.
 
• **Acetylene (C₂H₂**) - A hydrocarbon used in welding and as a **building block for the synthesis** of other chemicals.
 
• **Ethylene (C₂H₄**) - An important industrial gas used to** produce polymers **and other chemicals.
 
• **Propane (C₃H₈**) - A related hydrocarbon gas, often used as fuel for** heating and cooking.**
 
• **Pentane (C₅H₁₂)** - A hydrocarbon that is a component of **gasoline **and used in the manufacture of solvents.
 
• **Hexane (C₆H₁₄)** - Another hydrocarbon, used as a solvent in the extraction of** vegetable oils** and in various industrial processes.
 
• **Cyclohexane (C₆H₁₂)** - A cycloalkane used as a solvent and in the **production of nylon.**
